children: VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / September 17, 2026 /
Empress Royalty Corp.
(OTCQX:EMPYF) ("
Empress
" or the "
Company
") announces that trading in its common shares, which was halted by the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization ("
CIRO

") on September 17, 2026, pending the announcement of the Company's US$62M acquisition of a gold stream on the Tongon Gold Mine and the related US$75M debt financing, is scheduled to resume at market open on Friday, September 18, 2026, or as otherwise determined by CIRO in accordance with the policies of the TSX Venture Exchange.

As announced, the Company's wholly-owned subsidiary, Empress Royalty Holding Corp. ("Empress Holdings"), has entered into a Stream Purchase Agreement with Appian Tongon Streamco Ltd. to acquire a gold stream on the Tongon Gold Mine in Côte d'Ivoire for an upfront cash payment of US$62M. In connection with the acquisition, Empress Holdings, as borrower, has also entered into a US$75M senior secured credit facility with Appian Empire Loanco Ltd., consisting of an initial draw of US$55M at closing to partially fund the acquisition and a further US$20M available to fund future royalty and stream acquisitions.
Full details of the transaction are set out in the Company's news release dated September 17, 2026, which is available here:
https://www.empressroyalty.com/news/160494
"The Tongon gold stream will be a landmark addition to Empress' portfolio and marks our entry into West Africa, one of the world's premier gold producing regions,"
states Alexandra Woodyer Sherron, CEO and President of Empress.

"The investment brings a significant gold stream over a large, well established producing mine, together with a strong operating partner with Atlantic Group into our portfolio and sets the stage for Empress's next chapter. We thank our shareholders for their patience during today's trading halt and encourage them to view the recording of our investor webinar for a detailed walk through of the transaction as we work toward closing."

About Empress Royalty Corp.

Empress is a global royalty and streaming company providing investors with a diversified portfolio of gold and silver investments. The Company has strategic partnership with Endeavour Financial which allows Empress to not only access global investment opportunities but also bring unique mining finance expertise and deal structuring. Empress is looking forward to continuously creating value for its shareholders through the proven royalty and streaming models.
